title: 第222章 剑诛五魔传便南乡府第211章 纪雪之忧
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 二人家中虽不及贺、霍那等百年大族根基深厚，却也算得上府城有头有脸的门第。
纪雪的处境她们心里自然门清。
可清楚归清楚，真要她们伸手帮衬，却是万万不能的。
贺途南出身贺家，本人又是听泉院二弟子，位高权重。
她们日后若有机缘入摘星内门，少不得还要与贺途南打交道。
为一个下县来的‘姐妹’触贺途南的霉头？
这笔账，怎么算都不划算。
曾婉然垂下眼帘，重新剥了一颗蜜饯送入口中，仿佛什么都没听见。
汪灵儿端起茶盏，借着氤氲的水汽掩去面上微妙的尴尬。
雅间里静了一瞬，旋即又被曾婉然若无其事的轻笑声填满：
“灵姐姐，你还没说完呢，那封无阙落败之后，可有什么说道？”
汪灵儿微微一笑，正要答话时…
“哗啦！”
忽地，雅间竹帘被人用力掀开，一个小丫鬟小跑着撞进来！
正是汪灵儿的贴身丫鬟秋月。
汪灵儿柳眉微蹙，面露不悦：
“秋月，这般慌慌张张，成何体统。”
小丫鬟跑得鬓发散乱，脸上红扑扑的，上气不接下气，喘了两口气才拍着胸口道：
“小姐，不是奴婢放肆，是门内出大事了！”
“千池岛宝鱼塘，今晨有内门弟子私通魔教，暗中窃取宝鱼，结果被值守弟子撞破，爆了一场惊天大战！”
唰！
汪灵儿与曾婉然闻言，玉眸霎时圆睁，不约而同地站起身来，齐声惊道：
“勾结魔道？！”
连一旁原本满腹愁绪的纪雪闻言，美眸都不由泛起惊异。
摘星门多年来，与阴煞派等魔道势力厮杀不休，门下四院弟子因此死伤不计其数。
这等名门正派的内门弟子竟勾结魔道，简直是泼天丑闻！
“当真是那魔教贼子！现在整个南乡府城的各大茶楼、武馆，都彻底传疯了！”
秋月小脸涨得通红，眼中满是兴奋的光，语速飞快：
“那个通魔的卢贼，有人瞧见他朝广武府逃去了，执法堂已派高手去追杀了！”
小丫鬟咽了口唾沫，神色亢奋道：
“小姐，这还不是最惊人的！”
“更精彩的是，潜入千池岛的魔道贼子，乃是近年声凶名赫赫的‘苍梧六魔’！”
content_en:
Although their families are not as deep-rooted as He, Huo Na and other century-old families, they can still be regarded as a prestigious family in Fucheng.
They were naturally aware of Ji Xue's situation.
But what is clear is that if they really want to help, they will never be able to do so.
He Tunan was born in the He family, and he was the second disciple of Tingquan Academy, holding a high and powerful position.
If they have the opportunity to enter the inner sect of Star Reaching in the future, they will inevitably have to deal with He Tunan.
To bring trouble to Tunan for a 'sister' from the lower county?
This account is not worthwhile no matter how you calculate it.
Zeng Wanran lowered her eyes, peeled another candied fruit and put it in her mouth, as if she didn't hear anything.
Wang Ling'er picked up the tea cup and used the dense water vapor to cover up the subtle embarrassment on her face.
The private room was silent for a moment, and was soon filled with Zeng Wanran's chuckle as if nothing had happened:
"Sister Ling, you haven't finished speaking yet. What did Feng Wuque say after his defeat?"
Wang Ling'er smiled slightly and was about to answer...
"Wow!"
Suddenly, the bamboo curtain in the elegant room was opened forcefully, and a little maid ran in!
It was Qiuyue, Wang Ling'er's personal maid.
Wang Ling'er frowned slightly, showing displeasure:
"Qiuyue, how can you behave in such a panic?"
The little maid ran so hard that her temples were disheveled, her face was flushed, and she was out of breath. She took two breaths before patting her chest and saying:
"Miss, it's not that this slave is acting arrogant, it's that something big happened inside the door!"
"In the treasure fish pond on Qianchi Island, this morning there was an inner disciple who had an affair with the Demon Cult and secretly stole the treasure fish. As a result, the disciple on duty broke into it and a shocking battle broke out!"
Uh-huh!
When Wang Ling'er and Zeng Wanran heard this, their jade eyes widened instantly, they stood up in unison, and exclaimed in unison:
"Colluding with the devil?!"
Even Ji Xue, who was originally full of melancholy, couldn't help but be surprised when she heard this.
The Star Reaching Sect has been fighting endlessly with the Yinsha Sect and other demonic forces for many years, resulting in countless deaths and injuries among the four disciples under the sect.
It is a scandal that such a prestigious and upright inner disciple actually colludes with the devil!
"It's really that demon sect thief! Now the news has gone completely crazy in all the teahouses and martial arts schools in Nanxiang Fucheng!"
Qiuyue's little face turned red, her eyes were full of excitement, and she spoke quickly:
"That Lu Thief, who is a master of demons, was seen escaping towards Guangwu Mansion. The Law Enforcement Hall has sent experts to hunt him down!"
The little maid swallowed her saliva and said excitedly:
"Miss, this isn't the most amazing thing!"
"What's even more exciting is that the demon thief who sneaked into Qianchi Island is the 'Six Demons of Cangwu' who have become famous in recent years!"
title_en: Chapter 222 Slaying the Five Demons with Swords and Legend of Nanxiang Mansion Chapter 211 Ji Xue’s Worry
